name: 84070 · Sandy, UT
findings: ZIP 84070 (Sandy) has 166 nonprofit organizations. 60 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84070 (Sandy) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 84070 (Sandy) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
